verdict.rationale: ADK does not document a bulk-operations capability, meaning a feature that acts on many items at once. Its Workflow Runtime offers fan-out/fan-in, loops and dynamic nodes, but these are developer building blocks for constructing such processing, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit. Running eval sets via `adk eval` is a separate testing feature and does not carry over to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
